title: bot.activate
description: No-payload command that activates a bot.

child_operation_ceiling_ms.description: How long a cognition stage may take in all before the bot reboots, in milliseconds (the backstop; the turn's own processing_timeout_ms still bounds the whole turn); absent, the cognition's default (decision D101) [floppy field].

child_operation_timeout_ms.description: How long a cognition stage may go without progress before the bot reboots, in milliseconds; a streamed reasoning reply's progress starts it over; absent, the cognition's default (decision D101) [floppy field].

model.description: The model the bot's model-backed abilities ask the generate service for; absent, each ability's default [floppy field].

revising_ceiling_ms.description: How long reflection's revision through the builder may take in all before it fails, in milliseconds (the backstop); absent, reflection's default (decision D101) [floppy field].

revising_timeout_ms.description: How long reflection's revision through the builder may go without progress before it fails, in milliseconds; each builder stage and each streamed generation's progress starts it over; absent, reflection's default (decision D101) [floppy field].
